1先说结论

The short version: six things the best skin-scan image posts have in common
📌
这里收藏远多于点赞，所以「可对照」比「好看」重要。一篇肤质自测的收藏是点赞的 98%，一篇手绘步骤图收藏 14.5 万。观众存下来是为了下次洗脸时翻出来对照，所以每一页最好都能单独看懂，别依赖前一页。 Saves beat likes, so being referenceable matters more than being pretty. One skin-type self-test gets saves equal to 98% of its likes; a hand-drawn steps sheet gets 145K saves. People keep these to check against their own face later, so every page should stand on its own.
@炎知知 1.77 万藏 / 1.82 万赞@小透明 14.5 万藏@橙多拉 1.02 万藏 / 1.08 万赞
🖼
封面只有两种赢法：真人脸贴色块，或者一张信息图。把八张真人脸各贴一块彩色区域拼成九宫格，是三万赞的封面；反过来，一张纯白底、只有图标和四步的图，收藏率 91%。中间那些精修美图反而没人存。 Two cover types win: real faces with colour patches, or one clean information graphic. Eight real faces each with a coloured patch made a 30K-like cover. The opposite — a plain white sheet with icons and four steps — gets 91% saves. The polished beauty shots in between get saved by nobody.
@流氓兔 3.02 万赞 · 1.23 万转@岩松 Dylan 4.73 万藏 / 5.21 万赞@CIZ悉知 1.46 万藏 / 1.98 万赞
📱
手机截图就是一篇「检测报告」。有人把三款免费测肤 App 的界面一页页截下来，红圈圈出按钮和结果，1.7 万赞；另一条把原图和调参后的「检测图」并排，第二页直接给参数。你们的机器出报告的那块屏，本身就是最好的图文素材。 A phone screenshot is a scan report. One post screenshots three free skin-test apps page by page, circling buttons and results in red: 17K likes. Another puts the raw selfie beside the orange "scan" version and gives the sliders on page two. The screen your device produces a report on is already the best material you have.
@Serena S. 1.69 万赞@Yokiiiii 9553 赞 · 5133 藏
🎯
标题就一句自测口令，越像指令越好。「1s 轻松判断自己肤质」「一分钟教你自测肤色」「一图看懂」「你是哪一种」——这些标题的共同点不是形容词，而是一个可以立刻执行的动作加一个时间。 The title is an instruction with a clock in it. "Judge your skin type in one second", "one minute to test your undertone", "one image to understand it", "which one are you" — none of these sell; each is an action you can do right now plus a time.
@DD魔幻扫帚美妆 1s 判断 → 2.27 万赞@一颗星星 一分钟 → 1.55 万赞 · 5780 评@CIZ悉知 一图看懂 → 1.98 万赞
🎨
色卡和色块是被反复复刻的一套视觉。十二格肤色色卡配一张「举着手机照镜子」的示意图，2.4 万赞；另一条只用四块手掌色块做冷暖皮对比，也有一万多赞。同一套视觉被不同账号反复拍，说明观众已经认得它——你们的检测结果如果能做成这样的卡片，传播成本会低很多。 Colour cards and colour patches are the visual everyone reuses. Twelve skin-tone swatches plus one photo of someone holding a phone up to a mirror: 24K likes. Another post uses four palm-shaped colour patches for the warm/cool test and still gets 10K+. The same visual keeps being re-made because viewers already recognise it — if your report can become a card like this, it travels for free.
@阿懒♥姐姐 2.45 万赞 · 17530 藏@PM的日记 2.34 万赞@一颗星星 3923 转
🧾
想显得专业，就贴文献和解剖图。一篇自测图文的第二页是一张学术期刊截图，讲胶原降解，收藏率 98%；另一篇用手绘脸加皮下解剖示意，一张图就够。观众不需要读懂，他们需要「这是有依据的」这个感觉。 Borrow authority with a paper and an anatomy drawing. One self-test post opens with a screenshot of a journal paper on collagen breakdown and lands 98% saves. Another uses a hand-drawn face over a cross-section of the skin, one image only. Viewers don't need to read it; they need the feeling that there is evidence behind it.

210 种拍法，每种怎么拍

The 10 formats: a main example, a smaller example of the same idea, and how to make it with your product
1

一图一种 · 六格模板One page per skin type

封面先给六格总览，后面每一种肤质一页，每页结构完全一样：头像标部位、特征三条、建议三条。七页做下来像一个系列，观众会一页页翻完。

The cover gives a six-up overview, then one page per skin type, every page built the same way: a head with the zones marked, three traits, three suggestions. Seven pages read as a series, so people swipe to the end.

粉橘底、同一套模板，六种肤质各一页。

Peach background, one template, six pages. Take from it: the cover is a six-up index, so viewers instantly know how many pages are worth swiping.

📷 用你们的测肤镜这样发How to make it with your own device

拍什么Shots
封面一张六格索引；后面每种肤质一页。用你们机器拍到的真实分区图当头像，比卡通更贵气。One six-up index cover, then a page per skin type. Use a real zone map from your device instead of a cartoon head — it reads as more premium.
标题Title
「1 秒看懂自己是什么皮｜六种肤质对照表」
"One second to know your skin type | a six-type chart".
正文Body
第一行写「洗完脸什么都不涂，等 10 分钟」。下面按肤质分段，每段三行以内，最后一句引导：评论区告诉我你是哪种。Open with "wash and put nothing on, wait ten minutes". Then one short block per skin type, three lines each, ending with "tell me yours below".
别做Don't
别在每页都放产品图。这一篇的任务是「对照」，产品放在第 8 页或下一篇。Don't put the product on every page. This post's job is comparison; the product goes on page eight or in the next post.
2

真人脸贴色块Real faces, colour patches

八张真人脸，每张在出油或泛红的区域贴一块半透明色，拼成一张封面，标题只有一句「教你快速辨别肤质」。这是全组最强的封面。第二页放「准备工作」，把自测的前提条件说清楚。

Eight real faces, each with a translucent patch over the oily or flushed zone, tiled into one cover with a single line of title. The strongest cover in the set. Page two is the prep page that makes the test valid.

Eight faces in one cover, then a page per type on a beige paper ground. Take from it: page two explains how to prepare, so the whole post feels like a test instead of a claim.

📷 用你们的测肤镜这样发How to make it with your own device

拍什么Shots
找 6–8 个人（同事就行），同一面墙、同一盏灯、正脸。用你们机器的分区结果上色，色块要半透明，别盖住五官。Six to eight people (colleagues are fine), one wall, one lamp, straight on. Colour the patches from your device's zone output — translucent, never covering the features.
标题Title
「八张脸告诉你：你的皮其实不是你以为的那种」
"Eight faces: your skin type isn't what you think it is".
正文Body
第一段写测试条件（洗脸上什么都不涂、等多久、什么光线下看）。第二段列六种肤质各一句。结尾问「你是哪一种」。First paragraph: the test conditions. Second: one line per skin type. End with "which one are you".
别做Don't
色块不要超过两种颜色，也别做成彩色渐变——那看起来像滤镜，不像检测。Never more than two patch colours, and no gradients — that reads as a filter, not a scan.

Plain white, no person, no scene: three rows (morning, evening, weekly), four product silhouettes with names each. 52K likes, saves at 90% of likes. The cheapest to make and the easiest to keep.

📷 用你们的测肤镜这样发How to make it with your own device

拍什么Shots
不用拍。做一张 3:4 的信息图：左边是你们的检测流程四步，右边是四个结果模块（肤质/水分/毛孔/色斑），用线连起来。No shooting. Make one 3:4 graphic: the four steps of your scan on the left, four result modules on the right, connected by lines.
标题Title
「一张图看懂 AI 测肤报告｜别再只看分数」
"One image to understand an AI skin report | stop looking only at the score".
正文Body
三段：这张图怎么读、哪两项最该先管、下次复测隔多久。不要写成分，也不要写价格。Three paragraphs: how to read the chart, which two metrics to act on first, how long to wait before re-scanning. No ingredients, no prices.
别做Don't
别放产品实物图。一张图里出现真产品，就会被当成广告。No product photo. One real product in the frame turns the whole sheet into an ad.

📷 用你们的测肤镜这样发How to make it with your own device

拍什么Shots
把你们 App 的「开始检测 / 扫描中 / 结果页 / 历史对比」四个界面截下来，每页只圈一个重点。Screenshot four screens of your app — start, scanning, result, history — and circle exactly one thing per page.
标题Title
「不用去店里｜在家 3 分钟看完整份测肤报告」
"No store needed | a full skin report at home in three minutes".
正文Body
写清楚三件事：在哪打开、要拍几张、报告里哪一项最值得看。最后提示「隔两周再测一次对比」。Three facts only: where to open it, how many photos it takes, which metric to read first. Close with "scan again in two weeks and compare".
别做Don't
别裁掉状态栏和手机边框。有手机边框，观众才知道这是真实截图而不是设计稿。Don't crop the status bar or the phone frame. The frame is what makes it read as a real screenshot rather than a mock-up.

📷 用你们的测肤镜这样发How to make it with your own device

拍什么Shots
一张真人举手机对镜的照片（必须是这个动作），加上你们报告里的色值卡截图，切成若干页。One photo of someone holding a phone up to a mirror — it has to be that action — plus the tone card from your report, split across pages.
标题Title
「举着镜子测肤色｜12 个色号对一遍就知道」
"Test your undertone in the mirror | run through twelve swatches and you'll know".
正文Body
把方法写成三步：亮度拉满、站到窗边、把手机举到脸旁照镜子。每步一行，别加形容词。Method in three lines: brightness up, stand by the window, hold the phone beside your face in the mirror. No adjectives.
别做Don't
别用打光棚拍色卡。色卡一旦有色差，整篇就废了；直接在自然光下拍实物。Don't shoot the card under studio light. A colour cast kills the entire post — shoot the real card in daylight.
6

一张微距图 + 一个问句One macro shot, one question

📷 用你们的测肤镜这样发How to make it with your own device

拍什么Shots
用你们机器最高的放大倍率，拍一块问题皮肤，占满画面。背景要暗，别让头发和衣服入镜干扰。Shoot one problem patch at your device's highest magnification, filling the frame. Keep the background dark and the hair and clothes out.

正文Body
只写三行：这是什么位置、多久了、你们机器测出来是哪一项偏高。不要给诊断结论。Three lines only: where it is, how long it's been there, which metric your device scores high. No diagnosis.
别做Don't
别在图上加箭头和红圈。这张图的力量来自「没有解释」，一加标注就变成广告图。No arrows, no red circles. The power here is that nothing is explained — annotate it and it becomes an ad.

4每一篇都用得上的 6 件事

Six things that work in every post
  • 封面只放一个结论。不要「五個小技巧」这种封面。一张脸、一句话、一个色块，就够了。One conclusion on the cover. No "five little tips" covers. One face, one line, one colour patch is enough.
  • 每页都能单独看懂。收藏的人会只截图其中一页。别写「如上所述」，也别让第二页才解释第一页。Every page must stand alone. People screenshot a single page. Never write "as above", and never make page two explain page one.
  • 用你们报告里的真实截图。这是这个品类最缺、也最贵的东西。截图别修图，只加红圈。Use the real screenshot from your report. It is the scarcest and most valuable asset in this category. Don't retouch it — only add a red circle.
  • 标题带时间和动作。「3 分钟」「洗完脸」「举着镜子」「对一下」——时间和动作让读者知道要花多少力气。Put a time and an action in the title. "three minutes", "after washing", "in the mirror", "compare it" — time and action tell people how much effort this costs.
  • 结尾留一个问题。「你测出来是哪种」这种问题能带来几百条评论，也让下一篇有素材。End on a question. "Which one did you get" pulls in hundreds of comments and gives you material for the next post.
  • 别在图上放二维码和门店地址。小红书会限流，而且观众一看就知道是广告。门店信息写在正文最后一行。No QR codes or store addresses on the image. RedNote throttles it, and viewers read it as an ad instantly. Put store info in the last line of the caption.
所有图文：3:4 竖版，第一页就是封面。同一篇里字体不超过两种、颜色不超过三种。真人出镜的那几张不要磨皮——这个品类里，皮肤纹理就是可信度。All posts: 3:4 vertical, page one is the cover. Two typefaces and three colours maximum across the whole post. Never smooth the skin in the real-face pages — in this category texture is the credibility.

How we found these

2026 年 11 月 19 日，小红书搜了 24 个：测肤、皮肤检测、肤质测试、肤质判断、测肤仪、AI测肤、皮肤检测仪、测肤报告、护肤plog、护肤日记、护肤清单、护肤步骤、换季护肤、烂脸自救、敏感肌护肤、油痘肌、毛孔、抗老、化妆镜、一图看懂、护肤红黑榜、成分党、探店、变美日记。按点赞排序。一共排了 775 篇测肤 / 护肤图文，逐张看了 37 篇。去掉的：搜「红黑榜」出来但其实是服装店榜单的、纯产品实拍加成分堆砌的软广、AI 生成的科普长图、以及和皮肤无关的同名笔记。产品换购页只留了两篇当版式参考。品牌植入的内容我们标成「品牌植入」，因为无法确认是否付费。

On 2026-11-19 we ran 24 Xiaohongshu searches, sorted by most likes, and ranked 775 skin and skincare image posts; 37 were checked image by image. Left out: a "red-black list" that turned out to be a clothing store ranking, pure product shots with ingredient padding, AI-generated explainer graphics, and unrelated notes sharing a keyword. Only two product pages were kept, as layout references. Sponsored-looking posts are marked "brand placement", because we can't confirm they were paid.
